result.summary: Found several layout and content issues, mostly related to cropped elements at the screen edge and a promotional banner with faded/low-contrast text.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal scroll section cuts off the third restaurant card (Trattoria Piccolo) at the screen edge, making the name and details partially unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Add a visual cue (e.g., partial card fade or peek indicator) or adjust card widths/spacing so cut-off content is clearly indicated as scrollable.

issues.description: Text in the '3 free deliveries for you' promotional banner appears low-contrast/faded against the light green background, especially the subtext.
issues.suggestion: Increase text color contrast or darken the banner background to improve readability.

issues.description: The category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) is cut off on the right edge, suggesting more categories exist but the cutoff isn't clearly indicated as scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient overlay at the edge or partial visibility of the next item to signal horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: The pizza promotion card at the bottom is abruptly cut off by the bottom navigation bar, with no visible restaurant name or details.
issues.suggestion: Ensure adequate spacing/padding so cards are not obscured by the fixed bottom navigation, or add scroll padding.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccolo' is truncated ('Piccol') due to card cutoff at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Use text truncation with ellipsis or ensure the full card is scrollable into view.
